headline: A federal law renames the Rayville, Louisiana post office building after Luke Letlow.
what_it_does: This act names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 103 Benedette Street in Rayville, Louisiana, the Luke Letlow Post Office Building. It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change postal services, mail rules, or staffing.
when_it_takes_effect: The act was enacted on November 25, 2024, and the designation took effect on that date.
